title: Plan had files in Shared Files Map but not in component estimated_files
description: The plan correctly listed libs/janus_core/pyproject.toml in the Shared Files Map (touched by python_backend_standards and EPIC_1) but did NOT include it in python_backend_standards' estimated_files list. Similarly, pnpm-lock.yaml was described as generated by frontend_standards but not in its estimated_files. create_issues_from_plan_swarm uses estimated_files to assign file ownership to swarm tasks. Files in Shared Files Map but not in estimated_files are effectively invisible to downstream task generation.
root_cause: plan_phase_epic treats Shared Files Map and estimated_files as independent sections. It doesn't cross-validate that every file mentioned in the Shared Files Map also appears in the appropriate component's estimated_files. The Shared Files Map documents WHAT is shared but doesn't ensure the file is also LISTED in the component that modifies it.
recommendation: Add a validation step to plan_phase_epic: after generating both the Shared Files Map and estimated_files for each component, cross-validate that every file in the Shared Files Map appears in at least one component's estimated_files. Also ensure generated files (lockfiles, build artifacts) are tracked in estimated_files.
affected_section: Parallelization Strategy generation — Shared Files Map and estimated_files cross-validation.
plan_context: Phase 1 Epic 2 — Tech Stack Standards, UV workspace monorepo
